EXTENDING THE EFFECTIVITY OF EO 371 s. 1996.
The Special Zone of Peace and Development (SZOPAD), the Southem
Philippines
for Peace and
Development
Consultative
Assembly (CA) are hereby extended for a one year period
corresponding to the period covered by RA 8753.

CONTINUITY
OF ORGANIZATION,
RESPONSIBILITIES. The organization,
and responsibilities
SPCPD and CA, as provided for in EO 371 shall continue to be in force
and effect in the period covered by this executive order.

3.
OF SPCPD WITH
DEVELOPMENT CONCERNS. With respect to peace and development
concems in SZOPAD, the SPCPD shall, pursuant to the 1996 Final Peace
Agreement, undertake the following additional tasks:
Directly supervise offices and projects located in the Special
Zone of Peace and Development particularly
the Southern
Philippines
Development
(OMA) and the National
Commission
Indigenous
People (NCIP) formerly Office of the Southern
Cultural Communities.
Forces such as the Basilan Development Task Force, the
Development Task Force and the Sulu
Development Task Force are also placed under the control and
supervision of SPCPD.

EFFECT ON LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS. Nothing in this
Executive Order shall effect the existence or diminish the powers and
laws of all local government
SZOPAD, including the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

FUNDING.
Funds for the operation of SPCPD and the
Consultative Assembly shall continue to be sourced from the Office of the
Presiden t and from such other funding sources as may be recommended
by the Department of Budget and Management.

EFFECTIVITY CLAUSE. This Executive Order shall take
effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two newspapers of national
circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this~th
